description: We are looking for a full-time Analytics Engineer in-house (m/f/d) to join our motivated global Insights team starting as soon as possible in the Stockholm or Munich office.

lists.content:
As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions. 
 
As a vital member of our international IT organization, you will be involved in the foundation of our internal product development and will join the cross-functional data team that is responsible for developing and maintaining Netlight's business-critical data platform and strives to decentralize analytics. That is why it is important that you are a self-driven person, who is comfortable with taking initiative and responsibility, as well as a service-minded and communicative team player.

• A trusted communicator who builds relationships across technical and non-technical stakeholders and translates data into decisions

  • Self-driven and proactive, but also team-oriented, with sound judgment on when to lean on AI tools for speed and when human oversight and design thinking matter more 

  • Comfortable working in ambiguity — organized yet flexible, able to adapt as tools, priorities, and team structures evolve quickly 

  • A curious, fast learner with a growth mindset — genuinely energized by new tools, AI-assisted workflows, and continuously raising your own technical bar

• Based in Stockholm or Munich 

  • A degree in a quantitative field (e.g. software engineering, computer science, economics, mathematics, statistics) — if you think you’re a great fit, we want to hear from you! 

  • At least 2+ years of relevant experience in fields like Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, or Software Development.  

  • Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience building and testing data models in dbt on a cloud warehouse, and an understanding of dimensional data modeling (star schemas, facts and dimensions) 

  • Solid grasp of version control with Git, including CI/CD workflows for data pipelines 

  • Familiarity with Python for data transformation, automation, and light pipeline work 

  • Fluent in written and spoken English (business level) 

  • Comfort working with AI copilots and AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g. Copilot-style code/doc generation, AI BI assistants) while maintaining human oversight on data quality and design 

  • Bonus: Experience with, or strong interest in, semantic layers and metric governance — ensuring a single, trusted definition of key business metrics that both humans and AI tools can rely on

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions. 
 

Data Modeling & Quality 

  • Transform raw data into clean, usable datasets for analytics and business intelligence, and AI use cases. 

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain a semantic layer and single source of truth for key business metrics. 

  • Ensure data quality and consistency across teams and tools. 

  • Build and maintain robust, well-documented data models using Snowflake and dbt. 


Governance & Enablement 

  • Provide compliant, user-friendly access to data across various tools (e.g. Power BI, Excel, or AI-powered BI assistants). 

  • Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need. 

  • Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end, balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements. 

  • Maintain clear documentation and metadata (data catalog, definitions, lineage, ownership) so both people and AI tools can trust and correctly interpret the data 


Optimization & Agile Delivery 

  • Continuously evaluate and improve data models for performance and scalability. 

  • Contribute to agile ways of working, participating in planning, refinement, and delivery cycles. 

  • Stay current with emerging tools and practices in the data stack (e.g. orchestration, observability, AI-assisted development) and help the team adopt what's genuinely useful.

• The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry - and contribute to the continued growth of our thriving Stockholm office.
  • Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
  • Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
  • A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
  • Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription) 
  • Mental health & parental support offerings 
  • 30 days of paid vacation. 
    •  
    Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich: 
  • Deutschlandticket
  • Wellpass 
    •  
    Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm: 
  • 5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”) 
  • Private pension savings

lists.text: A Day in the Life at Netlight
lists.content:
• Design and build robust, scalable data platforms and pipelines in close collaboration with data scientists, analytics teams, and business stakeholders. 

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of data solutions, from architecture and pipeline development to testing, deployment, orchestration, and monitoring.

  • Develop high-quality, scalable solutions for complex data challenges across streaming and batch processing, data warehousing, lake architectures, and analytics enablement.

  • Use and build with AI day-to-day - from AI-assisted coding to designing and shipping AI-powered features - to move faster and deliver more value to clients.

• At Netlight, instead of predefined roles, we tailor positions to fit individuals. On the basis of your experience, strengths, interests and market demand; you take charge of your career path by defining the roles you take on with a variety of clients.
  • Netlight is a highly engaged network organization where you connect with peers, seniors, mentors, coaches, EDGE networks, and social circles.
  • We build solutions across diverse domains - backend, frontend, cloud, mobile, data engineering, infrastructure, product, UX/UI, and more.
  • We have a flat organizational structure with no traditional bosses. We foster collaboration, autonomy, and shared responsibility, empowering everyone to contribute and shape their own career path.

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent.
  • 1-4 years of experience in software engineering after graduation.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Based in Toronto; this is a 100% in-person role.
  • Legally eligible to work in Ontario, Canada.
  • Curiosity about multiple industries and technologies.
  • Tech agnostic mindset with proficiency and experience in some of the following: Python, Databricks, PySpark or Spark, SQL, Airflow, Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) 
  • Strong communication skills
  • Proficiency with using and building with AI: comfortable working with AI coding assistants/agents, and experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into products.

• The unique opportunity to be part of building a local company and leading the development of an emerging Netlight office: driving the growth of one of our 15 offices. This is the opportunity to engage in a perfect sweet spot between a scale-up and an established company.
  • Competence development is core and realized through a culture of knowledge sharing, feedback, professional coaching and mentorship.
  • An international working environment – access to a diverse network of 2,000+ highly talented individuals
  • Regular Summits where you connect with the rest of Netlight internationally.
  • Modern tech equipment and a centrally located office space.

• Transparent salary development throughout your career with semi-annual compensation reviews
  • For this role, candidates can expect a starting base salary of CA$95,000 – CA$109,000. Total starting compensation ranges from CA$95,000 – CA$125,000, consisting of base salary and variable salary. Actual compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and role level.
  • Variable salary is our version of a bonus program and, it is paid out bi-weekly together with your base salary. The amount is based in part on your seniority and on the group performance of Netlight
  • 20 paid vacation days prorated per calendar year
  • 10 paid Care Days (sick/personal days) per year with unlimited additional unpaid sick days
  • Extended Health Benefits and Dental Care including an additional CA$1,000 HSA and CA$500 Wellness Account (taxable)

About the role
As a Data Platform & Data Architecture Consultant, you are the person clients trust to turn their data infrastructure from a bottleneck into a competitive advantage. You design data landscapes, stand up and scale cloud data platforms, and set the guardrails that let entire organisations build on data safely and efficiently.
Our consultants bring varied paths and perspectives to this work. What unites them is structural thinking, a drive to understand the business context behind every technical decision, and the ability to operate across both the blueprint and the build. Across engagements, you may operate as a data architect, lead a platform build, or contribute at the strategic advisory level, often blending several of these roles within a single engagement.
 
What the work looks like
Building and operating platforms. You design, provision, and harden cloud data platforms end to end, covering storage and compute, networking, security and IAM, observability, and cost. You codify infrastructure using tools like Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation and establish governance frameworks such as data catalogs, data contracts, RBAC models, and SLAs that let organisations scale data access without losing control. You build platforms that multiple teams and business domains can rely on, not just at launch, but as they grow.
Shaping the data architecture. You design logical and physical data models, map data flows and lineage across systems, and make the structural decisions that determine how data is organised, integrated, and consumed. This can mean designing a target-state architecture for a client migrating from legacy systems to a modern cloud lakehouse, or defining domain boundaries and data product interfaces in a data mesh adoption.
Advising and translating. You sit at the intersection of technology and business. You work with data engineers, data scientists, product owners, and senior client stakeholders to understand what they need, then turn that into platform strategy and architecture decisions. You are the person a CTO trusts to make the right call on how their data infrastructure should evolve.

We're growing our Sales & Growth-team in Gothenburg during the spring of 2026
Are you driven by the thrill of building something new? At Netlight, we are launching our Gothenburg office, and we’re looking for bold individuals to not only join our Sales & Growth team, but help shape our entire Gothenburg presence from the ground up. This is more than a sales role; it’s a unique intrapreneurial opportunity to be a foundational team member and office builder, with direct impact on our culture and future in Western Sweden.
 
Job Description
We are looking to strengthen one of our core teams, our business development and sales team, for our brand new Gothenburg office, starting in the spring of 2026.
Your main responsibility will be around technical sales. The role involves finding and establishing new clients and engagements, maneuvering existing client engagements, as well as collaborating closely with consultants at Netlight to find a great match between Netlighters and client engagements.
 
What’s unique about this position: As part of launching our Gothenburg office, you will have an intrapreneurial opportunity to help build and shape our local presence from day one. We are looking for someone with an “office builder” mentality, an individual excited by the challenge and reward of establishing and growing a new office, culture, and community together with us. To fit into this role you will probably be a person who is driven by exploring the tech market, helping people unleash their potential, and building Netlight.
 
Requirements
Graduating in 2024 or 2025.
Master's degree / Engineering degree.
Verbal and written fluency in Swedish and English.
Passion for sales, business development, and the tech industry.
Experience in relevant areas to the role is a merit, but not a prerequisite, e.g. sales, business development, venture capital, start-ups, networking or similar, perhaps through internships, or engagement in student organizations.
 
We offer
The possibility to be a core part of growing one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry — and shape our new Gothenburg office from the ground up.
A long-term career. Competence development is core and realized through a culture of knowledge sharing, feedback, mentorship, and coaching.
An international working environment.
Fixed competitive salary and company-based bonus (no commissions).

description: We're looking for a Team Lead for Netlight's Platform team — the AI and developer-platform layer that every builder at Netlight relies on daily. You'll lead a team of engineers, own the reliability and evolution of that platform end to end, and give the team real space to push the developer experience work it's most excited about.

lists.content:
At Netlight, “Team Lead” is a defined role: you lead the team with a mix of Engineering Manager responsibilities (people health, tech health, and business impact) and Product Manager ones (problem discovery, stakeholder management, prioritization). You set direction and remove blockers day to day; goals, budget envelopes, and hiring decisions are set together with the Head of Tech, whom you’ll report directly to.

With your help, we want to:
  • Turn hard-won operational know-how into documented, resilient team capability — so uptime doesn’t depend on any one person’s memory.
  • Mature the team’s Builder Experience Foundation work — turning today’s developer sandbox environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP into genuinely production-grade platforms.
  • Build out the AI Platform's tooling and workflows so every builder at Netlight can adopt AI-assisted development with confidence and speed. 
  • Establish clear standards and self-service paths for platform onboarding, so new teams and projects can build on solid infrastructure from day one.

• Strong prioritization skills — comfortable running the role with a product mindset, balancing competing asks across the team.
  • Experience building or running a platform “as a product” — self-service paths, golden paths, service catalogs — rather than just keeping infrastructure operational. 
  • Self-driven innovative mindset.
  • A track record of advocating assertively for your team with leadership and stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills — able to translate technical trade-offs into business terms for non-technical stakeholders, and vice versa.

• At least 3 years of experience leading software engineering teams.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure and/or GCP) — enough to make informed calls and earn credibility with the team, even if you’re not hands-on daily.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous, high-pressure situations into smooth, well-run operations.
  • Work from a Netlight office at least 3 days per week.
  • Fluent in English. 
  • Swedish or German is a plus.
    •  
    Nice to have: 
  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD or similar developer infrastructure platforms.
  • Working in a Developer Experience or Platform Building group/team/area.
  • Direct experience with specific AI coding assistants or building custom LLM-based dev tooling.
  • Familiarity with cloud cost governance / FinOps.

You’ll lead a small but senior platform team responsible for everything from cloud landing zones to AI Tooling and surrounding builder-experience components (monitoring, CI/CD, service catalogue) — a team with real appetite to shift more energy into cloud and builder infrastructure, and your leadership is what makes that shift possible. You’ll work closely with the Head of Tech, Operations and Tech teams.
Your key responsibilities will be to: 
 
  • Team leadership and development : Set direction, coach, and grow a team of engineers; build a culture where ideas and concerns surface early.
  • Operational oversight: Own the day-to-day health of our cloud infrastructure and builder-experience platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Maintain oversight of GitLab and CI/CD infrastructure supporting Builders. Lead the documentation and knowledge-sharing work that makes the platform resilient by design, so uptime doesn't depend on any one person's memory.
  • Planning and execution: Shape the cloud infrastructure and AI Platform roadmap across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Balance stabilization work against the team's ambition to build strong builder infrastructure and sandbox environments across all three clouds, and drive the adoption of AI-assisted development tooling.
  • Communication and collaboration: Represent your team’s needs and constraints upward and advocate for them directly.
    Work with the team before making commitments that affect their scope, capacity, or working conditions.
  • Culture and engagement: Close the loop on feedback and follow through on commitments; build trust through consistency.

• The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry - and contribute to the continued growth of our thriving Stockholm office.
  • Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
  • Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
  • A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
  • Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription) 
  • Mental health & parental support offerings 
  • 30 days of paid vacation. 
    •  
    Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich: 
  • Deutschlandticket
  • Wellpass 
    •  
    Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm: 
  • 5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”) 
  • Private pension savings

Our Recruitment & Growth team in Copenhagen is growing!
Netlight is an award-winning consultancy providing premium IT services to companies ranging from startups, scaleups and established players in the digital industry. We are now expanding our ambitious and high-performingRecruitment & Growth team with a selfdriven individual who wants to be an essential part of growing of one of Europe’s leading IT consultancies.
 
The Role
Your main responsibility will be tech-recruiting (end-to-end). Additional areas you will be working within are talent management, business development, sales, data-driven growth strategies, university marketing, employer branding, event management, DEI, and project management based on your strengths and interests. You will be responsible for managing the whole process from the very first contact to a world-class onboarding. This involves networking, sourcing, interviewing, stakeholder management and other activities that connect to a long-term sustainable and successful growth of Netlight. To enjoy and succeed in this role, you are an ambitious person who is driven by meeting new people, learning about newest trends in the tech market, creating relations, and building a state-of-the-art consultancy company in the heart of the Inner City in Copenhagen.
 
Background
There has never been a time when the right people were more in demand and more valuable than today. To lead this change, Netlight rethought recruitment. Thus, the Recruitment & Growth team (Talent Search) was separated from Human Resources and is today one of three CORE business processes of Netlight together with Sales & Business Development (Engagement Search) and IT Consulting. These three core business processes are areas we excel in and constantly develop. You now have the opportunity to embark on our exciting growth journey!

We're looking forward to hearing from you!

  • Background in NLP, computer vision, or time-series forecasting in applied production settings. 

  • Experience with data and AI platform architecture, including feature stores, data lakes, and lakehouse patterns.

The Role: Business Development & Growth 
At Netlight, people are the business. Our continued success depends on our ability to grow with the right individuals—those who challenge, inspire, and build our future. We’re now looking for a new colleague to our People & Growth team to take on one of the most central responsibilities in our company: driving growth by recruiting the best people to Netlight.
 
You will lead and own the full journey of every recruitment process—from first conversation to a successful start—with high exposure across the organization. You’ll work closely with consultants and leadership to understand what the business needs next, and make it happen. The work is hands-on, analytical, project driven, people-centric and business-critical.
 
As part of the People & Growth team on the long term, you’ll also contribute to Netlight’s development in areas like mentorship, retention, our value proposition, and themes such as equality and culture.
 
You’re not here to fill roles—you’re here to build the company.
 
OR 
 
The role: Sales and Growth 
Your main responsibility will be around technical sales. The role involves finding and establishing new clients and engagements, manoeuvring existing client engagements, as well as collaborating closely with consultants at Netlight to find a great match between Netlighters and client engagements. You will work closely within sales and business development along with hands-on engagement with venture capital, start-ups and other exciting projects.
 
You will be a part of building one of the most successful tech consultancy companies in Europe, with hundreds of tech companies as clients.
 
To fit into this role you will probably be a person who is driven by exploring the tech market, helping people unleash their potential, and building Netlight.

Have you already or are you graduating in 2026 or 2027 with a tech-related degree?
Ready to start a job in one of our Offices in Germany? (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, Frankfurt or Cologne)
Passionate about IT, whether it is Software Engineering, Data& AI, Product/Project Management, UX, or Cybersecurity?
Already dreaming big about your post-Master’s career?
Living in one of our locations (or you could imagine to pack your bags and head here)?
Curious about Netlight and what IT consulting is all about?
Well, guess what? We’ve got something awesome just for you! 🚀
Apply now to get a spot on our next Netlight Talent Day on September 21st.
It’s your chance to experience what working at Netlight and diving into IT consulting is really like, all right here in Hamburg! And on top of that you will get the full NETLIGHT experience. Here’s what’s in it for you:
A glimpse into life at Netlight
Meet our incredible consultants + other ambitious talents from all over the country
Have 1-2 interviews to kickstart your journeyIt’s going to be an unforgettable day filled with insights, connections, and excitement! Let’s shape your future together.
 
Come work with us
Netlight strives to be a truly diverse, equitable and inclusive organization. Regardless of who you are, what personality, background, and experience you have, you enrich our culture through your values. Netlight’s purpose is to unleash full potential, realize great careers, and fulfill personal growth. To achieve this, we have a highly engaged network organization, where every employee gets a mentor, delivery coach and personal communities. The key to our continued success is trust and personal responsibility, diverse experiences, challenging opportunities and developing from personal values. Every Netlighter is an active part of building and shaping this culture, which leads to a clear correlation between personal growth and the growth of Netlight.
 
About us
Netlight provides a full range of premium IT-consulting services at the forefront of the digital industry and stands out for its product- and technology-independent expertise in a wide range of industries and clients. We are a network organization of more than 2 000 role models making aspiring digital leaders successful in their business-critical IT projects. Netlight has been awarded several times as top employer, as well as for growth, continued profitability and engagement for diversity, equity and equality within the IT industry. Today we are growing all across Europe, currently with more than 10 active international offices.
 
What does it mean to be an IT Consultant in Data/ AI/ Software Development at Netlight?
It will vary a lot between Netlighters as we, around the right person, will design a role together with you. You will be starting somewhere familiar. For example in web development? System development? Mobile Development? Data engineering? It is your call how your career at Netlight will look, ranging from which clients you will work with, what role you want to take (based on your personal experience, strengths, your personal interest) and how your relationship with your mentor/coach/EDGE networks/social networks will look like.
As a consultant at Netlight, you will build the products, systems and technical solutions of today and tomorrow. This means that our consultants get the opportunity to help build and scale existing and new products and companies and also continuously learn and master a variety of technical tools. At Netlight, we will challenge you. Our clients will challenge you. You will challenge our clients. You will challenge us. We will grow together and unleash the potential in each other.
Our projects are in the fields such as Backend Development, Frontend Development, Web Development, System Development, Cloud, Mobile Development, Architecture, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, DevOps, Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Scrum Master, Agile Coaching, Product Owner, UX-/UI-/Interaction Design and more.
Minimum Qualifications
Master Degree in Engineering or Technology
Verbal and written fluency in English (C1 or higher)
0,5-3 years of work experience related to IT next your Studies a Working Student or in Internships
Preferred Qualifications
Proven Track-record from previous positions (e.g. recognized achievements & deliveries)
Advanced/Bilingual (B2-C2) German
Application
We are always looking for new Netlighters, so feel free to apply if you meet the qualifications.
Process
We will get in touch with you within two weeks if we find that your profile and experiences are a match beyond the qualifications at this time. If your profile matches our needs we will reach out to you!

Join us at our Stockholm office on 5th November, 17th November and 25th November 
 
#1 THE FOUNDATION – Every icon needs a good base.
Focus on building a strong technical foundation in Data and Software through hands-on workshops.

• Collaborate with sales and technical teams to support pre-sales activities. 
  • Support the organization of Netlight Internal Partnerships initiatives, from writing guides and administrating partner portal to helping organize internal workshops, retrospectives and creating necessary operational structures.  
  • Support development of some of our sales support tools and integrations.   
  •  Partner with our sales and technical teams to develop and customize technical presentations and sales enablement materials. 
  • Conduct market research and competitor analysis to inform sales strategies to identify trends and opportunities for our Hyperscaler Partnerships.  
  • Gather and analyze client feedback to enhance our service offerings. 
  • Develop Marketing strategies for new business offerings for our Hyperscaler Partnerships.   
  • Support in organizing events together with partners 
  • Develop funding and business offerings in conjunctions with consultants

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program, ideally in Engineering, Business with a technical focus, or a related field. 
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, engaging content that bridges engineering, sales, and marketing for diverse audiences. Experience with  presentation software, interest and willingness to  learn necessary design tools. Motivated self-starter with a proactive, hands-on attitude. 
  • Entrepreneurial attitude to dive into new business models, develop attractive product value propositions and create new approaches to marketing and service offerings.  
  • Strong organizational skills and experience in using collaboration and productivity tools 
  • Analytical mindset and strong research skills with a high degree of accuracy. 
  • Proficiency in both German and English; additional languages are a plus. 

    • Nice to have
  • Understanding of hyperscalers and the underlying business models. 
  • Online Marketing experience

• Part-time position up to 20 hours per week. 
  • Opportunity to be part of a strategic and global initiativewith a lot of space to grow and have high impact 
  • A culture that values performance and considers personal needs, with short decision-making paths and a tolerant, open community. 
  • Ability to work with senior leaders to grow and evolve  
  • Application Process: If you are passionate about contributing to the success of the railway system and eager to develop your career in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your qualifications and interest in the role. Netlight is committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences.

The industry is referring to a "war for talent". There has never been a time when the right people were more in demand and more valuable than it is today. We are truly in the people economy, which means that recruitment is not only crucial but also a significant competitive advantage. To lead this change, we rethought recruitment (though, you will recognize the buzzwords below).

As a working student you will be part of the creative and high-performing Talent Management Team in Hamburg, one of three core processes of Netlight. Your main responsibility will be around active sourcing, university collaborations, events, recruitment and other processes connected to the growth of Netlight. You will get insights into the whole recruitment process, from the first contact to a world-class onboarding of our new colleague into Netlight. This involves networking, sourcing, project management, internal and external employer branding, and other activities that connect to the long-term sustainable and successful growth of Netlight.

Get a sneak peek into our team here: https://vimeo.com/756760283/e3c10dbe83

Please apply by following the link, including your up-to-date CV.
If we find that your profile matches what we are looking for, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying.

We're looking forward to hearing from you! :)
